name: Velocity Minecraft Network (Paper Lobby)
description: Minecraft proxy with a private Paper lobby and modern player forwarding.

PORT.description: Private supervisor HTTP port used by Railway healthchecks; keep 8080.

HEAP_MB.description: Maximum Java heap in MiB; proxy default 384, separate from container overhead.

EULA.description: References explicit Minecraft EULA acceptance on Lobby; never accepted automatically.

FORWARDING_SECRET.description: Shared modern-forwarding secret; reference the Lobby generated variable.

MAX_PLAYERS.description: Displayed player capacity; references the lobby setting.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Save and stop gracefully before Railway terminates the old container.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_OVERLAP_SECONDS.description: Disable overlapping deployments against persistent game state.

BACKEND_HOST.description: Private lobby hostname; never point to a public TCP proxy.

MOTD.description: Multiplayer server list message; at most 200 characters.

PORT.description: Private supervisor HTTP port used by Railway healthchecks; keep 8080.

HEAP_MB.description: Maximum Java heap in MiB; allocate at least 3-4 GB container RAM including Java overhead.

EULA.description: REQUIRED: enter true only after accepting https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA.

FORWARDING_SECRET.description: Generated shared modern-forwarding secret; 32-128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Save and stop gracefully before Railway terminates the old container.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_OVERLAP_SECONDS.description: Disable overlapping deployments against persistent game state.

VIEW_DISTANCE.description: Chunk view distance, 2-16; lower values reduce world CPU and RAM.

WHITELIST_ENABLED.description: Set true to require the persisted Paper whitelist; no accounts or operators are added automatically.

MOTD.description: Multiplayer message, at most 200 characters; Velocity passes through this backend status.
